\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
Letters right after inline math stay on the line of the math, as in the
$i$th row, the $n$th and $(n+1)$st terms, and a gap of $-4$pt. So do
the letters after math that follows a no-break space, as in the~$k$th
entry.

\begin{theorem}The $i$th row is zero.\end{theorem}

So is \emph{the $n$th term} of the sequence, and the last
entry.\footnote{See the $k$th entry.}
\end{document}
